snippet.title: Arctic Eggs | Out Now on XBOX Series X|S | CRTime
snippet.description:
Available today on XBOX Series X|S, and coming soon to PlayStation 5 and Nintendo Switch.
Can you fry eggs on top of Mount Everest? Find out in Arctic Eggs, the critically acclaimed surreal physics-based frying simulator from developer The Water Museum.

Out now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2763670/Arctic_Eggs/
Out now on XBOX: (link coming soon)
